Details 
 The Commander Resistor™ designed with innovative technology and engineered for superior comfort and durability.
 This 11” Resistor is crafted with high-tech innovation from the inside out. Built on our new lightweight UltraHex™ platform, it features an Ortholite® insert for comfort and breathability and a strong shock-absorbing honeycomb midsole to reduce foot fatigue during a long day’s work. It’s equipped with our nano composite toe - our strongest, most lightweight safety toe that’s designed with added toe room. On the ground, the abrasion-resisting, slip-resisting and oil-resisting outsole delivers exceptional durability with long-lasting wear. This boot meets ASTM F2413 safety footwear standards.
 Details
- Upper: Premium Full Grain Leather
- Lining: Woven
- Insole: Ortholite® Insert
- Toe Shape: Square
- Construction: Cement
- Shank: Non-Metallic
- Outsole: Oil and Slip Resisting Rubber
- Safety Features: Nano Comp Toe, EH, Waterproof, Oil and Slip Resisting, meets ASTM F2413 Safety Footwear Standards
